history: Retain the original challenge, pre-repair manifest, evidence, each concise review and the accepted post-repair manifest. Repairs remain confined to the canonical owner. A repeated unchanged challenge stops and returns to evidence collection.

items.expect: The knowledge repair request is valid.
Evidence and manifest files match their digests.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the missing or changed evidence.

items.expect: The response satisfies the knowledge repair contract.
The response binds this request revision.
Artifact files are scoped and digest-correct.

onFail.instruction: Re-read bytes and repair the artifact or metadata.

items.expect: Observations reference declared criteria and evidence.
Concrete evidence applies to the challenged rule and case.

onFail.instruction: Name the evidence gap and ask for a directly applicable observation.

items.expect: The smallest canonical owner contains the complete repair.

onFail.instruction: Remove duplicated or unrelated edits and repair the one owner.

items.expect: Published identifiers and thresholds remain stable.

onFail.instruction: Restore stable addresses and append cases or retire explicitly.

items.expect: The result binds a fresh rerun on the same originating surface.

onFail.instruction: Correct manifest and rerun references without claiming acceptance.

items.expect: Knowledge write, validation and Git capabilities are available.

onFail.instruction: Return blocked with the exact missing capability.

items.expect: Challenge, canonical owner, manifest, evidence and rerun target are supplied.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the missing evidence or binding.

items.expect: Transient validation failures do not duplicate commits.

onFail.instruction: Inspect current knowledge and Git state, then retry only the incomplete validation.

stopWhen: Return done only when every criterion and criteriaResults entry passes; then require the originating operation to reevaluate the same surface. Stop after two feedback rounds or an unchanged repeated failure.
